do_now: Check that your wearable was worn and fitted correctly last night.
cards.ground_escalation: Optional: queue a note for the flight surgeon; replies may be delayed.
cards.heading: Physiological change
cards.onboard_escalation: Tell the onboard CMO if you have symptoms or if this continues for another night.
cards.uncertainty: These changes are nonspecific. Poor sleep, hard exercise, stress or illness can all cause them. This is not a diagnosis.
cards.why: {signals} have moved away from your preflight normal for {days} nights in a row.

do_now: Follow the mission-approved symptom assessment procedure.
cards.ground_escalation: CMO decides whether to message the flight surgeon; message is queued if the link is down.
cards.heading: Physiological change — check symptoms
cards.recheck: As directed by the CMO or the approved procedure.
cards.uncertainty: The pattern can occur with illness but does not confirm one.
cards.why: {signals} have shifted strongly or together with reported symptoms ({symptoms}).

do_now: Follow the mission-approved procedure for this symptom.
cards.ground_escalation: CMO decides; queued if the link is down.
cards.heading: Symptom needs attention
cards.uncertainty: SpaceHealth cannot assess this symptom. A person must.

do_now: Plan a protected sleep opportunity tonight if the schedule allows.
Consider extra cross-checks on safety-critical tasks today.
cards.ground_escalation: Optional: queue a schedule note for ground planners.
cards.heading: Sleep shorter than your normal
cards.onboard_escalation: Tell the onboard CMO if you feel impaired or this continues.
cards.uncertainty: Sleep estimates from a wrist device can be off. This does not measure how alert you are.
cards.why: You slept {hours} h, below your usual range, for {nights} nights.

do_now: Tell the onboard CMO and the commander before starting safety-critical tasks.
Arrange a protected recovery sleep opportunity as soon as the schedule allows.
cards.ground_escalation: Queue a schedule note for ground planners.
cards.heading: Sleep debt building up
cards.uncertainty: In sleep-restriction studies, alertness kept falling with accumulated sleep loss while people felt only slightly sleepier. How you feel may underestimate the effect.
cards.why: Over the last 7 nights you slept {debt_h} h less than your preflight normal — about one full night of lost sleep.

do_now: Follow the mission's approved solar particle event procedure now, including moving to the designated shelter if the procedure says so.
cards.ground_escalation: Log for ground; the procedure does not wait for a reply.
cards.heading: Solar particle event warning
cards.onboard_escalation: Confirm with the crew/commander that everyone is following the procedure.
cards.uncertainty: Dose so far today is {dose_today} mSv{partial_text}.

do_now: Review upcoming activities that add dose with the crew.
cards.ground_escalation: Queue a budget summary for ground.
cards.heading: Radiation budget
cards.onboard_escalation: Discuss with the commander/CMO if planned activities would exceed the mission plan.
cards.uncertainty: {career_unknown_text}Background rate measured on the way to Mars was about 1.84 mSv/day.
cards.why: Mission dose {mission_dose} mSv{career_text} — {pct}% of the 600 mSv career limit.
